source: USGS global and controlled Galileo monochrome imagery with inferred visible ice/non-ice color
naturalColorReference: NASA/JPL/DLR PIA00502 left natural-color hemisphere; appearance constraint, not a georeferenced global RGB source
colorModel: Near-neutral ice and restrained brown endmember on dark image features; local contrast moderates chroma. Inferred chroma, no geologic unit-color painting
limitations: No measured global RGB. Source illumination remains partly baked. Image brightness constrains inferred appearance, not measured material identification. Regional/global control networks differ. Polar color is inferred.
